name: Holofernes
description: Chief captain of Nabuchodonosor's army, sent to avenge the king upon the nations of the west; mustered a hundred and twenty thousand footmen and twelve thousand horsemen, conquered the nations along the way, besieged Bethulia and cut off its water, heard Achior the Ammonite's report of Israel and had him cast out for it, received Judith in his camp and was deceived by her beauty, and was beheaded by her in his own tent while he lay drunk with wine

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Holofernes
cases.charge: Making Nebuchadnezzar a god; blasphemy against the God of Israel; lust and drunkenness
cases.preview: Nabuchodonosor sent his chief captain Holofernes with a great host to bring every nation under him and to destroy all their gods, so that he alone should be called god (Judith 2:4-13;
